'''Viron Ghartoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who charted fresh [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] in the [[spinward]] extremes of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Ghartoth was also credited with the discovery of the [[Paralyngian dire slug]], a bloated [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropod]]. Ghartoth presented his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] patron, [[Gerba]], with the [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slugs]] in [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]]. Ghartoth was unaware that this would cause an allergic reaction in the Hutt, and from his sickbed Gerba ordered for Ghartoth to be slowly devoured by his captive [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]].<ref name="EtU" />
